propositions: Root disk on autodeploy host reaches 85% alarm threshold during quiescent main because no-op ticks (every ~2 min) skip docker prune, leaving garbage unclaimed between deploys.
prune_docker_caches() is defined after the line-228 no-op early exit in autodeploy.sh, making it uncallable from that code path without relocation.

A pressure-triggered prune on the no-op path, throttled to a minimum interval and armed only when root disk usage exceeds a tunable threshold (default 80%), can reclaim disk during quiescence without churn.
The root_disk_pct() and reclaim_under_pressure() helpers must be added to the helper block before line 228 to precede the no-op exit call site.
Prune failures on the pressure path must not alter the script's exit code or control flow, only log and emit an AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker.
New tunables (DISK_PRESSURE_PCT, PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL, PRESSURE_PRUNE_TS_FILE) must be overridable via /etc/rebar/autodeploy.env to avoid requiring host redeploy.
